purpose: Close the hidden per-transition resource question for the frozen exact-DP -> R33 -> affine/RUP macro as far as the current grammar permits, and remove theorem dependence on R33's magic default max_steps=100000 by deriving an input-dependent polynomial cap.

R33_cap.Lmax_safe: 2*C*max(1,V), because a canonical clause contains at most both signs of each variable before tautology deletion
R33_cap.claim: Every successful R33 rule application strictly decreases lexicographic CLV and introduces no fresh variable; clause count never increases. Therefore fewer than H successful rule applications are possible, and H loop iterations suffice for the final terminal/fixpoint check. H=O(C^2 V^2).

DP_envelope: At one pivot, p*n <= C^2/4; the canonical DP pool has O(C^2) clauses and O(C^2 V) literal mass.
RUP_envelope: On a formula of literal mass L and V variables, at most L successful single-literal strengthenings occur. Each proposal search tests at most L literal deletions; each UP run assigns at most V variables and scans O(L) literals per propagation round. A coarse deterministic bound is O(V*L^3) search work; independent replay is polynomial as well.
scan_composition: Scanning at most V pivots multiplies a polynomial per-pivot bound by V, hence remains polynomial. Certificate histories are polynomial because DP records contain O(C^2 V) literal data, R33 history length is polynomially bounded by H, and RUP history has at most L records with trails of at most V assignments.

execution.implement: theorem-safe wrapper r33_simplify_polycap(formula) calling canonical r33.simplify with H rather than the magic constant
execution.audit: compare default R33 and explicit polynomial-cap R33 on frozen controls and representative DP-forced formulas; require identical terminal, final formula, history and rule counts wherever default does not hit its cap
execution.resource_receipt: emit symbolic bounds from C,V and observed ledgers
